title: “You’re Banished!” The One Being Expelled Wasn’t Me, but a Silent Magical Girl
description:
Taking in a mistreated S-rank beauty and rising to the very top!

"You're banished!"

When rookie solo adventurer Garrion hears those words, he crosses paths with Teresa... a quiet mage who was just unceremoniously kicked out of the renowned S-rank party, the 'Sword of Glory.' Unable to walk away from the devastated girl, he steps in to comfort her, and the two decide to team up and start a new adventuring life together.

Meanwhile, the 'Sword of Glory' is rapidly falling apart without Teresa carrying their battles. Desperate and petty, the declining party begins plotting dirty tricks to frame her. To protect Teresa's newfound happiness and their peaceful days together, Garrion decides it's time to turn the tables and completely crush her former party!

Packed with laughs, wholesome moments with a sweet, slightly clumsy mage, and maybe even a spark of romance (?!)... this underdog fantasy adventure starts now!
author: Marusei
